        # iterable of bytes -- a bare bytes or bytearray object is not a
        # chunk container, a non-iterable container or a non-bytes element
        # are all ValueError, a bad element ending consumption at once --
        # checked before any lease is taken, any history is read or the path
        # is probed. The complete input is joined and verified in memory
        # before the target is touched, so field-for-field this accepts
        # exactly the complete contents import_all accepts and raises exactly
        # what import_all raises: malformed lines, fields, sequences and
        # digests are AuditChainStateError located by tenant, seq and the
        # input's physical line, a target that already holds an involved
        # tenant is AuditChainConflictError in input first-appearance order,
        # and input problems take strict priority over target state. An empty
        # concatenation is a no-op after validation returning [], creating
        # and reading nothing. On success the whole snapshot lands as one
        # indivisible block and the parsed records are returned in physical
        # order, identical objects to what import_all returns for the same
        # bytes; no failure path writes a single partial byte, and
        # shared-lease readers observe only the complete pre-commit or
        # post-commit state.
        data = self._join_chunks(chunks)
        return self.import_all(data)

    def import_all_range(self, data, expected_heads):
        # Multi-tenant segmented offline migration: the cross-tenant
        # counterpart of import_tenant_range. Several tenants' JSONL segments
        # (typically produced by export_tenant_range calls against a source
        # log) may interleave in one byte stream and are grafted onto this
        # log as one indivisible block, each tenant continuing from its own
        # known chain head named in expected_heads, without a network or
        # remote anchor. Records keep their original
        # tenant/seq/event/prev/hash values verbatim -- nothing is renumbered
        # or recomputed -- so verify/verify_all/verify_bytes/export_* validate
        # the merged log by the exact existing rules.
        #
        # Boundary first, exactly as every other entry point orders it: data
        # must be bytes and expected_heads must be a list whose members are
        # objects carrying exactly the keys tenant, expected_count and
        # expected_hash; the tenant crosses the standard-JSON boundary,
        # expected_count must be a non-negative plain int (bool rejected even
        # though it subclasses int; floats, strings and other types are too)
        # and expected_hash must be exactly the 64 lowercase hex characters
        # of a sha256 digest (an empty target chain is asserted with ZERO); a
        # canonical JSON tenant identity may appear at most once. All of that
        # is checked before any lease is taken, any history is read or the
        # path is probed, so an illegal call raises ValueError regardless of
        # target state or contention and creates nothing. Empty bytes are a
        # no-op after that validation: no file is created, no history is read
        # and no byte changes; the assertions themselves are not evaluated.
        if not isinstance(data, bytes):
            raise ValueError(f"data must be bytes, got {type(data).__name__}")
        if not isinstance(expected_heads, list):
            raise ValueError(
                "expected_heads must be a list, got "
                f"{type(expected_heads).__name__}"
            )
        assertions = []
        seen = set()
        for head in expected_heads:
            if not isinstance(head, dict) or set(head) != {
                "tenant", "expected_count", "expected_hash"
            }:
                raise ValueError(
                    "each expected head must be an object containing exactly "
                    "the keys 'tenant', 'expected_count' and "
                    f"'expected_hash', got {head!r}"
                )
            tenant = head["tenant"]
            expected_count = head["expected_count"]
            expected_hash = head["expected_hash"]
            _validate_json_value(tenant)
            _validate_required_count(expected_count)
            _validate_expected_hash(expected_hash)
            key = self._tenant_key(tenant)
            if key in seen:
                raise ValueError(
                    "duplicate tenant head assertion (same canonical JSON "
                    f"identity): {tenant!r}"
                )
            seen.add(key)
            assertions.append((tenant, expected_count, expected_hash))
        if not data:
            return []
        # The complete input is verified in memory, before the target is ever
        # touched: strict UTF-8 JSONL, every physical line an object carrying
        # exactly the five existing fields of a listed tenant, each asserted
        # tenant present at least once (tenants may interleave), seqs running
        # expected_count+1, expected_count+2, ... from a first prev equal to
        # the asserted hash and every digest recomputed. Parse failures,
        # missing/extra fields, duplicate keys, non-standard numbers, blank
        # lines, non-objects, illegal UTF-8 or a listed tenant without
        # records are missing; sequence defects are sequence; prev/hash
        # mismatches are digest -- all raised as AuditChainStateError located
        # by tenant, seq and the input's physical line number (tenant/seq
        # None when they cannot be determined), the first defective physical
        # line deciding; input problems take priority over every target-side
        # state. A record of a canonical tenant identity no assertion lists
        # violates the input contract and is a ValueError, also decided by
        # first physical line against the chain defects above. Nothing is
        # read from the target and nothing is written on any input failure.
        lines, bad_line = self._decode_lines(data)
        try:
            records = self._scan_import_ranges(lines, bad_line, assertions)
        except _ForeignTenant as ft:
            raise ValueError(
                "import data must contain only tenants named by "
                f"expected_heads; a record of another tenant appears at "
                f"line {ft.line}"
            ) from None
        # Target scan, the head comparisons and the append share one
        # exclusive lease (the same one append_many_if_heads uses: the
        # data-file lease on an existing log, the directory lease guarding
        # the missing-file branch), so check-and-commit is a single atomic
        # operation. A not-yet-existing log may be created only when every
        # assertion is the exact empty-chain head (0, ZERO); any other
        # assertion is a deterministic conflict against the (0, ZERO) actual
        # head that leaves no file -- the lease derives that rule from
        # assertions before opening the path.
        norm = [
            (tenant, None, expected_count, expected_hash)
            for tenant, expected_count, expected_hash in assertions
        ]
        with self._heads_lease(norm) as f:
            # Only the chains this input involves are scanned. A corrupt
            # involved chain raises AuditChainStateError (same
            # tenant/seq/reason/line as append, first physical line then
            # expected_heads order deciding across chains) and takes strict
            # priority over the head comparisons; damage to an uninvolved
            # tenant is ignored. The state is never compared against an
            # unverifiable chain.
            target = f.read()
            t_lines, t_bad = self._decode_lines(target)
            heads = {}   # serialized tenant -> (count, head)
            broken = []  # (line, assertion_index, AuditChainStateError)
            for idx, (tenant, _ec, _eh) in enumerate(assertions):
                try:
                    count, head = self._scan(tenant, t_lines, t_bad)
                except _Broken as b:
                    seq = b.at if b.at is not None else b.expect
                    broken.append((
                        b.line, idx,
                        AuditChainStateError(tenant, seq, b.reason, b.line),
                    ))
                else:
                    heads[self._tenant_key(tenant)] = (count, head)
            if broken:
                raise min(broken, key=lambda x: (x[0], x[1]))[2] from None
            # Every involved chain is valid. Compare the assertions in
            # expected_heads order; the first mismatching one raises with its
            # expectation and the chain tail observed inside the lease. A
            # conflict writes no byte.
            for tenant, expected_count, expected_hash in assertions:
                count, head = heads[self._tenant_key(tenant)]
                if count != expected_count or head != expected_hash:
                    raise AuditChainConflictError(
                        tenant, expected_count, expected_hash, count, head
                    )
            # All heads confirmed: each segment's first prev names exactly
            # the matching target tail, so the graft links seamlessly. One
            # O_APPEND write commits the whole stream as a single block,
            # re-serialized verbatim with the exact canonical rule
            # append/export use (sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False); other
            # tenants' interleaved records already on disk stay in place and
            # shared-lease readers observe only the complete pre-commit or
            # post-commit state. The records are returned in the input's
            # physical order.
            chunks = [
                json.dumps(item, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False) + "\n"
                for item in records
            ]
            prefix = b"" if (not target or target.endswith(b"\n")) else b"\n"
            f.write(prefix + "".join(chunks).encode("utf-8"))
            return records

    def read_tenant(self, tenant, start_seq=1, page_size=None):
        # Read-only, single-tenant paged view. Returns plain record dicts
        # (each carrying exactly the tenant/seq/event/prev/hash fields with
        # their on-disk values) ordered by ascending seq; records of other
        # tenants may interleave on disk but never appear here or move the
        # page boundaries, since seqs are the target tenant's own 1..count.
        #
        # Every input crosses its boundary before any byte is read: the tenant
        # uses the same standard-JSON rule as append/verify/export, and
        # start_seq/page_size must be unambiguous positive integers (bool is
        # rejected even though it subclasses int; floats and other types are
        # too), with page_size additionally allowed to be None. A rejected
        # call reads nothing and, via the read-only snapshot below, can never
        # create or alter the log.
        _validate_json_value(tenant)
        if isinstance(start_seq, bool) or not isinstance(start_seq, int) \
                or start_seq < 1:
            raise ValueError(
                f"start_seq must be a positive integer, got {start_seq!r}"
            )
        if page_size is not None and (
            isinstance(page_size, bool) or not isinstance(page_size, int)
            or page_size < 1
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                "page_size must be a positive integer or None, got "
                f"{page_size!r}"
            )
        # One shared-lease snapshot, exactly as verify/export use: the result
        # is the full tenant history either wholly before or wholly after any
        # concurrent append, never a torn page. A missing path or an unknown
        # tenant is simply an empty chain and yields [].
        data = self._read_snapshot()
        lines, bad_line = self._decode_lines(data)
        try:
            # The whole tenant history -- first record through chain tail --
            # must verify with the exact JSON identity, sequence and digest
            # rules of verify before a single record is surfaced. Slicing
            # happens only after this, so a broken chain raises
            # AuditChainStateError (same tenant/seq/reason/line location as
            # verify/append/export) even when the requested page lies entirely
            # before the damage; no verified prefix is ever returned.
            self._scan(tenant, lines, bad_line)
        except _Broken as b:
            seq = b.at if b.at is not None else b.expect
            raise AuditChainStateError(tenant, seq, b.reason, b.line) from None
        # Snapshot proven valid: collect the target tenant in physical order
        # (identical to seq order for that tenant), then take the page purely
        # in memory. A start past the current count or a short tail page just
        # yields the available suffix, possibly [], rather than an error.
        key = self._tenant_key(tenant)
        records = []
        for raw in lines:
            item = _strict_loads(raw)
            if self._tenant_key(item["tenant"]) == key:
                records.append(item)
        lo = start_seq - 1
        if page_size is None:
            return records[lo:]
        return records[lo:lo + page_size]

    def head(self, tenant):
        # Read-only chain-head query: the exact (count, hash) pair a caller
        # can feed straight into append_if_head/append_batch_if_head as
        # (expected_count, expected_hash), without reading the log itself.
        # Returns {"tenant": tenant, "count": count, "hash": hash} with the
        # tenant value echoed back exactly as passed.
        #
        # The tenant crosses the same standard-JSON input boundary as
        # append/verify/export_tenant, checked before any byte is read, so an
        # illegal value raises ValueError without touching the log and takes
        # priority over any history state. A missing or empty log, or a log
        # without any record of this tenant, is a legitimate empty chain and
        # yields count=0, hash=ZERO; other tenants' records never count.
        _validate_json_value(tenant)
        # One shared-lease snapshot, exactly as verify/export/read use: the
        # result corresponds to the full state wholly before or wholly after
        # any concurrent append, never a torn read. Even though only the
        # chain tail is reported, the tenant's complete chain -- first record
        # through tail -- must verify with the exact JSON identity, sequence
        # and digest rules of verify: a corrupt prefix or suffix raises
        # AuditChainStateError (same tenant/seq/reason/line as
        # append/export_tenant, reason only missing/sequence/digest) instead
        # of surfacing a head computed over a broken history. The scan never
        # creates or modifies the log and writes no cache.
        data = self._read_snapshot()
        lines, bad_line = self._decode_lines(data)
        try:
            count, last = self._scan(tenant, lines, bad_line)
        except _Broken as b:
            seq = b.at if b.at is not None else b.expect
            raise AuditChainStateError(tenant, seq, b.reason, b.line) from None
        # _scan yields prev=ZERO for an empty chain, so the empty case falls
        # out of the same rule as a non-empty one. A head observed here can
        # still lose a later race; that is exactly what the conditional
        # append's conflict semantics are for.
        return {"tenant": tenant, "count": count, "hash": last}

    def _verify_snapshot(self, tenant, data, expected_count=None):
        # Core of verify over an exact in-memory snapshot: the same JSON
        # canonicalization, tenant identity and digest rules as the file path,
        # but the bytes are given and never touched on disk. Backs both verify
        # (file snapshot) and verify_bytes (caller snapshot).
        lines, bad_line = self._decode_lines(data)
        try:
            count, _ = self._scan(tenant, lines, bad_line)
        except _Broken as b:
            return {"ok": False, "at": b.at if b.at is not None else b.line, "reason": b.reason}
        if expected_count is not None:
            if count < expected_count:
                return {"ok": False, "at": count + 1, "reason": "missing"}
            if count > expected_count:
                return {"ok": False, "at": expected_count + 1, "reason": "sequence"}
        return {"ok": True, "count": count}

    def verify(self, tenant, expected_count=None):
        # Both arguments cross their boundary before any history is read, in
        # the exact order verify_bytes uses: the tenant first (same standard-
        # JSON input boundary as in append/append_batch: NaN/Infinity/
        # -Infinity, non-string object keys, cyclic containers and values
        # without a standard JSON encoding raise ValueError here, never
        # TypeError/RecursionError from a downstream json.dumps), then
        # expected_count, which must be None or a non-negative plain int
        # (bool is rejected even though it subclasses int; floats, strings
        # and other types are too). Both raise before the file is opened, so
        # a rejected call never sees a verdict computed against a corrupt or
        # missing file, leaves every byte untouched and creates nothing --
        # the file below is opened read-only regardless.
        _validate_json_value(tenant)
        _validate_expected_count(expected_count)
        return self._verify_snapshot(
            tenant, self._read_snapshot(), expected_count
        )

    def verify_bytes(self, data, tenant, expected_count=None):
        # Pure in-memory, offline entry point. The caller hands over the raw
        # bytes of a JSONL history (a single-tenant export, or a full log with
        # interleaved tenants); this never reads, creates or modifies the path
        # this AuditChain points at and never touches the network. Results are
        # byte-for-byte the same verdicts verify would give for identical file
        # contents, including physical line numbers and first-error priority.
        # Inputs cross their boundary before any parsing, and a malformed
        # buffer surfaces only as a missing/sequence/digest verdict -- the
        # underlying parse exception is never leaked.
        if not isinstance(data, bytes):
            raise ValueError(f"data must be bytes, got {type(data).__name__}")
        _validate_json_value(tenant)
        _validate_expected_count(expected_count)
        return self._verify_snapshot(tenant, data, expected_count)

    def verify_all_bytes(self, data):
        # In-memory counterpart of verify_all over a caller-supplied snapshot:
        # same tenant first-appearance order, counts and first-error structure.
        # Empty bytes are a legitimate successful empty history, and like
        # verify_bytes this neither reads nor creates the configured path.
        if not isinstance(data, bytes):
            raise ValueError(f"data must be bytes, got {type(data).__name__}")
        return self._verify_all_snapshot(data)

    @staticmethod
    def _join_chunks(chunks):
        # Validate and concatenate a chunked byte history. chunks must be an
        # iterable whose every element is bytes; a bare bytes or bytearray
        # object is not a chunk container (its iteration would yield ints)
        # and raises ValueError up front, as does a non-iterable container.
        # Element types are checked lazily while consuming: the first
        # non-bytes element raises ValueError immediately, without pulling
        # any further element from the iterable. Empty chunks are allowed and
        # an empty iterable is the empty history. Chunks may be cut at any
        # byte boundary -- mid-UTF-8-sequence, mid-line or mid-record --
        # since only the concatenation is ever decoded.
        if isinstance(chunks, (bytes, bytearray)):
            raise ValueError(
                "chunks must be an iterable of bytes, got a single "
                f"{type(chunks).__name__} object"
            )
        try:
            iterator = iter(chunks)
        except TypeError:
            raise ValueError(
                "chunks must be an iterable of bytes, got "
                f"{type(chunks).__name__}"
            ) from None
        parts = []
        for chunk in iterator:
            if not isinstance(chunk, bytes):
                raise ValueError(
                    f"each chunk must be bytes, got {type(chunk).__name__}"
                )
            parts.append(chunk)
        return b"".join(parts)

    def verify_chunks(self, chunks, tenant, expected_count=None):
        # Chunked offline counterpart of verify_bytes for large histories:
        # the caller hands over the JSONL history as an iterable of bytes
        # chunks in file order instead of one contiguous buffer, so the
        # caller never has to assemble the full bytes itself. Chunks may be
        # cut at any byte boundary (mid-UTF-8-sequence, mid-line, mid-record)
        # and empty chunks are allowed; only their concatenation is the
        # history. Like verify_bytes this consumes only caller data: it never
        # reads, creates or modifies the configured path, never touches the
        # network, and keeps no cache or on-disk index.
        #
        # Boundary first, in the exact order verify_bytes uses: the chunk
        # container must be an iterable of bytes (a bare bytes or bytearray
        # object, a non-iterable container or a non-bytes element are all
        # ValueError, a bad element ending consumption at once), then the
        # tenant crosses the same standard-JSON boundary as append/verify,
        # then expected_count must be None or a non-negative plain int (bool
        # rejected even though it subclasses int). The verdict over the
        # concatenated bytes is field-for-field the verdict verify_bytes
        # would return for the same bytes, including physical line numbers,
        # first-error priority and the expected_count check.
        if isinstance(chunks, (bytes, bytearray)):
            raise ValueError(
                "chunks must be an iterable of bytes, got a single "
                f"{type(chunks).__name__} object"
            )
        _validate_json_value(tenant)
        _validate_expected_count(expected_count)
        return self._verify_snapshot(
            tenant, self._join_chunks(chunks), expected_count
        )

    def verify_all_chunks(self, chunks):
        # Chunked offline counterpart of verify_all_bytes: every tenant chain
        # in the history is validated over the concatenation of the given
        # bytes chunks, supplied in file order. Chunks may be cut at any byte
        # boundary and empty chunks are allowed; an empty iterable is a
        # legitimate successful empty history. The result -- ok, at, tenant,
        # reason on failure, or the tenant list with counts and
        # first-appearance order on success -- is field-for-field the verdict
        # verify_all_bytes would return for the concatenated bytes. Like
        # verify_all_bytes this consumes only caller data: it never reads,
        # creates or modifies the configured path, never touches the network,
        # and keeps no cache or on-disk index. The container must be an
        # iterable of bytes; a bare bytes or bytearray object, a non-iterable
        # container or a non-bytes element are all ValueError, a bad element
        # ending consumption at once.
        return self._verify_all_snapshot(self._join_chunks(chunks))

import json
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory

from app import AuditChain

ZERO = "0" * 64


def record_bytes(item):
    return (json.dumps(item, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False) + "\n").encode("utf-8")


class VerifyBytesTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.tmp = TemporaryDirectory()
        self.path = Path(self.tmp.name) / "audit.jsonl"
        self.chain = AuditChain(self.path)
        self.other = AuditChain(self.path.with_name("never-touched.jsonl"))

    def tearDown(self):
        self.tmp.cleanup()

    def seed(self):
        self.chain.append("a", {"i": 1})
        self.chain.append("b", {"i": 1})
        self.chain.append("a", {"i": 2})
        self.chain.append("a", {"i": 3})

    def snapshot(self):
        return self.path.read_bytes()

    # --- never touches the configured path ---

    def test_never_reads_creates_or_modifies_constructor_path(self):
        # point at a nonexistent path, then only ever call verify_bytes
        chain = AuditChain(self.path.with_name("phantom.jsonl"))
        self.assertEqual(chain.verify_bytes(b"", "t"), {"ok": True, "count": 0})
        self.assertFalse(self.path.with_name("phantom.jsonl").exists())
        self.seed()
        before = self.snapshot()
        self.assertTrue(chain.verify_bytes(before, "a")["ok"])
        self.assertEqual(self.snapshot(), before)
        self.assertFalse(self.path.with_name("phantom.jsonl").exists())

    def test_does_not_mutate_data(self):
        self.seed()
        data = self.snapshot()
        self.other.verify_bytes(data, "a")
        self.other.verify_all_bytes(data)
        self.assertEqual(data, self.snapshot())

    # --- equivalence with file-backed verify ---

    def test_matches_verify_on_single_tenant_export(self):
        self.seed()
        exported = self.chain.export_tenant("a")
        self.assertEqual(self.other.verify_bytes(exported, "a"),
                         self.chain.verify("a"))
        self.assertEqual(self.other.verify_bytes(exported, "a", 3),
                         {"ok": True, "count": 3})

    def test_matches_verify_on_interleaved_full_log(self):
        self.seed()
        data = self.snapshot()
        for tenant, count in (("a", 3), ("b", 1)):
            self.assertEqual(self.other.verify_bytes(data, tenant),
                             self.chain.verify(tenant))
            self.assertEqual(self.other.verify_bytes(data, tenant),
                             {"ok": True, "count": count})
        self.assertEqual(self.other.verify_bytes(data, "zzz"),
                         {"ok": True, "count": 0})

    def test_matches_verify_expected_count_short_and_over(self):
        self.seed()
        data = self.chain.export_tenant("a")
        r = self.other.verify_bytes(data, "a", 4)
        self.assertEqual((r["ok"], r["at"], r["reason"]), (False, 4, "missing"))
        r = self.other.verify_bytes(data, "a", 2)
        self.assertEqual((r["ok"], r["at"], r["reason"]), (False, 3, "sequence"))
        r = self.other.verify_bytes(data, "a", 0)
        self.assertEqual((r["ok"], r["at"], r["reason"]), (False, 1, "sequence"))

    def test_empty_bytes_is_successful_empty_history(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.other.verify_bytes(b"", "t"), {"ok": True, "count": 0})
        self.assertEqual(self.other.verify_bytes(b"", "t", 0), {"ok": True, "count": 0})
        self.assertEqual(self.other.verify_all_bytes(b""),
                         {"ok": True, "tenants": []})

    def test_distinct_json_identities_stay_partitioned(self):
        for t in (1, 1.0, True, "1"):
            self.chain.append(t, {})
            self.chain.append(t, {})
        data = self.snapshot()
        for t in (1, 1.0, True, "1"):
            self.assertEqual(self.other.verify_bytes(data, t),
                             {"ok": True, "count": 2})

    def test_object_tenant_key_order_normalized(self):
        self.chain.append({"a": 1, "b": 2}, {})
        self.chain.append({"b": 2, "a": 1}, {})
        data = self.snapshot()
        self.assertEqual(
            self.other.verify_bytes(data, {"b": 2, "a": 1}),
            {"ok": True, "count": 2})

    # --- verdicts mirror verify exactly ---

    def write_raw(self, *chunks):
        self.path.write_bytes(b"".join(chunks))

    def valid_row(self, tenant="t", seq=1, prev=ZERO, event=None):
        row = {"tenant": tenant, "seq": seq, "event": event or {}, "prev": prev}
        row["hash"] = AuditChain._hash(row)
        return record_bytes(row)

    def test_malformed_lines_are_missing_at_physical_line(self):
        for raw, at in ((b"\n", 1), (b"   \n", 1), (b"[1,2]\n", 1),
                        (b"{not json\n", 1),
                        (self.valid_row("x") + b"{not json\n", 2)):
            r = self.other.verify_bytes(raw, "t")
            self.assertEqual((r["ok"], r["at"], r["reason"]),
                             (False, at, "missing"), raw)

    def test_missing_field_is_missing(self):
        row = {"tenant": "t", "seq": 1, "event": {}, "prev": ZERO}
        raw = (json.dumps(row) + "\n").encode()
        r = self.other.verify_bytes(raw, "t")
        self.assertEqual((r["at"], r["reason"]), (1, "missing"))

    def test_duplicate_key_non_standard_number_are_missing(self):
        for raw in (b'{"tenant":"t","tenant":"t","seq":1,"event":{},'
                    b'"prev":"' + ZERO.encode() + b'","hash":"x"}\n',
                    b'{"tenant":"t","seq":1,"event":{},"prev":"' + ZERO.encode()
                    + b'","hash":"x","x":NaN}\n',
                    b'{"tenant":"t","seq":1e999,"event":{},"prev":"'
                    + ZERO.encode() + b'","hash":"x"}\n'):
            r = self.other.verify_bytes(raw, "t")
            self.assertEqual((r["ok"], r["at"], r["reason"]),
                             (False, 1, "missing"), raw)

    def test_illegal_utf8_is_missing_at_physical_line(self):
        cases = [
            (b"\xff", 1),
            (self.valid_row() + b'{"tenant":\xff}', 2),
            (self.valid_row("x") + self.valid_row("y") + b"abc\xc2\n", 3),
        ]
        for raw, at in cases:
            r = self.other.verify_bytes(raw, "t")
            self.assertEqual((r["ok"], r["at"], r["reason"]),
                             (False, at, "missing"), raw)

    def test_sequence_and_digest_classification(self):
        good = self.valid_row("t", 1)
        gap_row = {"tenant": "t", "seq": 3, "event": {}, "prev": "x" * 64}
        gap_row["hash"] = AuditChain._hash(gap_row)
        r = self.other.verify_bytes(good + record_bytes(gap_row), "t")
        self.assertEqual((r["at"], r["reason"]), (2, "sequence"))

        bad_prev = {"tenant": "t", "seq": 2, "event": {}, "prev": "9" * 64}
        bad_prev["hash"] = AuditChain._hash(bad_prev)
        r = self.other.verify_bytes(good + record_bytes(bad_prev), "t")
        self.assertEqual((r["at"], r["reason"]), (2, "digest"))

    def test_other_tenant_bad_line_is_found_and_earlier_error_wins(self):
        # parse-broken line of another tenant is fatal to verifying t
        r = self.other.verify_bytes(b'{"tenant":"x", broken\n', "t")
        self.assertEqual((r["ok"], r["at"], r["reason"]), (False, 1, "missing"))
        # digest error for t on line 1 beats bad bytes on line 2
        tampered = {"tenant": "t", "seq": 1, "event": {"z": 9}, "prev": ZERO}
        tampered["hash"] = AuditChain._hash(
            {"tenant": "t", "seq": 1, "event": {}, "prev": ZERO})
        raw = record_bytes(tampered) + b"\xff\n"
        self.assertEqual(
            (self.other.verify_bytes(raw, "t")["at"],
             self.other.verify_bytes(raw, "t")["reason"]),
            (1, "digest"))

    # --- verify_all_bytes equivalence ---

    def test_verify_all_bytes_matches_verify_all(self):
        self.seed()
        data = self.snapshot()
        self.assertEqual(self.other.verify_all_bytes(data),
                         self.chain.verify_all())
        self.assertEqual(self.other.verify_all_bytes(data), {
            "ok": True,
            "tenants": [{"tenant": "a", "count": 3},
                        {"tenant": "b", "count": 1}],
        })

    def test_verify_all_bytes_first_error_structure(self):
        good = {"tenant": "a", "seq": 1, "event": {}, "prev": ZERO}
        good["hash"] = AuditChain._hash(good)
        bad = {"tenant": "b", "seq": 1, "event": {}, "prev": "f" * 64}
        bad["hash"] = AuditChain._hash(bad)
        raw = record_bytes(good) + record_bytes(bad)
        self.assertEqual(self.other.verify_all_bytes(raw),
                         {"ok": False, "at": 2, "tenant": "b", "reason": "digest"})
        self.assertEqual(self.other.verify_all_bytes(b"{oops\n"),
                         {"ok": False, "at": 1, "tenant": None, "reason": "missing"})
        self.assertEqual(self.other.verify_all_bytes(b"\xff"),
                         {"ok": False, "at": 1, "tenant": None, "reason": "missing"})

    # --- export written elsewhere agrees with in-memory verification ---

    def test_exported_bytes_in_memory_and_on_disk_agree(self):
        for i in range(7):
            self.chain.append("t", {"i": i})
            self.chain.append("other", {"i": i})
        exported = self.chain.export_tenant("t")
        mem = self.other.verify_bytes(exported, "t")
        out = self.path.with_name("written-back.jsonl")
        out.write_bytes(exported)
        disk = AuditChain(out).verify("t")
        self.assertEqual(mem, disk)
        self.assertEqual(mem, {"ok": True, "count": 7})
        self.assertEqual(self.other.verify_all_bytes(exported),
                         AuditChain(out).verify_all())

    # --- argument boundary: ValueError, no leaked parse exceptions ---

    def test_data_must_be_bytes(self):
        for bad in ('{"x":1}', bytearray(b""), 1, None, [b""]):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                self.other.verify_bytes(bad, "t")
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                self.other.verify_all_bytes(bad)

    def test_tenant_boundary_raises_value_error(self):
        for bad in (float("nan"), float("inf"),
                    {"k": float("nan")}, {1: "x"}, object(), b"x",
                    {1, 2}):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                self.other.verify_bytes(b"", bad)

        cyc = []
        cyc.append(cyc)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.other.verify_bytes(b"", cyc)

    def test_expected_count_boundary_raises_value_error(self):
        for bad in (-1, 1.0, True, False, "1", 1.0, object()):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                self.other.verify_bytes(b"", "t", bad)
        # valid values do not raise
        self.assertEqual(self.other.verify_bytes(b"", "t", None),
                         {"ok": True, "count": 0})
        self.assertEqual(self.other.verify_bytes(b"", "t", 0),
                         {"ok": True, "count": 0})

    def test_value_error_beats_corrupt_snapshot(self):
        # bad inputs raise even though the buffer itself is corrupt
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.other.verify_bytes(b"\xff", "t", -1)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.other.verify_bytes(b"\xff", float("nan"))
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.other.verify_bytes("not bytes", "t")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

1	# Audit Chain
2	
3	A dependency-free Python reference implementation for security, audit, transaction-graph.
4	
5	Run with: python3 demo.py
6	Tests: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
7	
8	## Scope
9	
10	实现按租户分区的追加审计日志：每条记录包含租户、顺序号、事件和前一条摘要，读取方可以离线校验完整历史并定位第一个损坏的位置。追加必须拒绝错误的前序状态，校验结果要明确区分缺失、顺序错误和摘要错误；日志格式保持可迁移，不依赖网络服务或远端锚定。
11	
12	租户身份按稳定的 JSON 数据身份划分（`json.dumps(..., sort_keys=True)`）：对象键顺序不影响身份，而 `1`、`1.0`、`true`、`"1"` 是四个互不相干的租户；append、verify、verify_all 共用同一套分区语义。
13	
14	输入与读取都遵循标准 JSON 边界：append 的 tenant 和 event 只能由 null、布尔值、有限整数/浮点数、字符串、数组和键为字符串的对象递归组成，NaN、Infinity、-Infinity、非字符串键及无法无歧义编码的值一律抛出 `ValueError`（先于任何追加动作，不写入任何字节）。verify 的 tenant 参数采用同一定义：非法值在读取历史或触碰路径之前抛出 `ValueError`（不泄露 TypeError/RecursionError 或 JSON 编码异常），已损坏的文件与非法 tenant 同时出现时同样是 `ValueError` 优先且字节不变；合法 tenant 的校验结果（missing/sequence/digest 及 expected_count 语义）保持不变。verify/verify_all 以同一规则解释历史：包含重复对象键、NaN/Infinity/-Infinity 或其他非标准 JSON 内容的物理行按 missing 类损坏处理并停在首次出现处。
15	
16	同一路径可被多个线程或进程同时读写而仍保持单一可验证历史：append 在整个"读取最新状态—计算 seq/prev/hash—追加"区间持有排他文件锁（`flock`，无第三方依赖），因此每条记录都基于其真正落盘前的最新完整状态计算，任何调用都不会覆盖既有字节；verify/verify_all 持共享锁读取，只会看到某次追加之前或之后完整自洽的文件视图，绝不会把写了一半的记录报成损坏。历史一旦损坏，并发 append 仍以相同的 tenant/seq/line/reason（missing、sequence、digest 之一）抛出 `AuditChainStateError` 且不改动文件。旧版 JSONL 文件格式不变，可继续直接验证。
17	
18	`append_batch(tenant, events)` 一次提交一组同租户事件：events 必须是列表（空列表直接返回 `[]`，不创建文件、不改动字节；其他类型一律 `ValueError`），租户与列表中每个事件沿用与 append 相同的标准 JSON 边界。成功时按输入顺序分配连续 seq——首条接在该租户当前链末（prev 为提交前最后一条记录的摘要），后续逐条引用批次内前一条摘要——并在同一次排他租约内以一个字节块整体追加，因此整批对其他追加/校验是一个不可分割的可见结果：同租户追加只能整体落在批前或批后，不同租户仍可交错且各自从 1 计数。落盘为每行一个 JSON 对象，与逐条调用 append 产生的字节和 verify/verify_all 计数、摘要、首个错误位置完全一致；扫描到与 append 相同的首个损坏点时抛出同样字段（tenant、seq、reason、line）的 `AuditChainStateError`，失败不留任何部分记录。
19	
20	`append_if_head(tenant, event, expected_count, expected_hash)` 是带前序断言的单条条件追加：调用方给出链头应有的记录数和末条摘要，只有二者与租约内实际读到的链头**同时**相等时才追加下一条。`expected_count` 必须是非负普通整数（`bool`、负数、浮点、字符串、`None` 及其他类型一律 `ValueError`），`expected_hash` 必须恰好是 64 个小写十六进制字符（长度不符、大写、非 hex 字符或非字符串一律 `ValueError`），空链的期望摘要使用现有 `ZERO`。tenant、event 继续沿用与 append 完全相同的标准 JSON 边界；所有非法值（含布尔计数、负数计数、格式不正确的摘要）都在读取日志或创建文件之前以 `ValueError` 结束，不创建、不修改日志。成功时返回值与 append 完全相同（同一记录 dict、同样的五个字段、seq、prev 与摘要算法），落盘字节与对相同历史调用 append 逐字节一致。断言格式合法但与当前链头不符时抛出新增的 `AuditChainConflictError`，公开 `tenant`、`expected_count`、`expected_hash`、`actual_count`、`actual_hash` 五个字段，且 `reason` 固定为 `"conflict"`；`actual_count` 为零时 `actual_hash` 为 `ZERO`，历史为空（日志不存在、为空或只含其他租户记录）时按同一规则比较，失败调用不写入任何字节——对尚不存在的日志作出非空断言尤其不会创建日志文件。历史损坏时沿用 `AuditChainStateError`：tenant、seq、line、reason 语义与 append/verify/export 完全一致，reason 仍只取 missing、sequence、digest，错误优先级与文件字节不变，且状态错误优先于冲突判定（不会拿不可验证的链去比较断言）。校验、比较与写入在同一次排他租约内完成：日志已存在时使用与 append 相同的数据文件排他锁；日志尚不存在时，排他目录取锁（普通 append 创建文件时同样短暂持有该锁）覆盖"探测不存在—空链比较—创建文件"整段，且文件只在断言获胜后才被创建，加锁顺序始终是目录锁先于文件锁，不会与普通 append 死锁。因此并发提交同一个链头时至多一个成功，其余调用都在锁内观察到获胜者写入的新链头并得到确定的冲突异常（actual_* 反映获胜后的真实计数与末条摘要）。append、append_batch、verify、verify_all、verify_bytes、verify_all_bytes、export_tenant、read_tenant 的签名、结果、JSONL 格式、租户身份区分及离线行为保持不变。

38	`read_tenant(tenant, start_seq=1, page_size=None)` 是只读的按租户分页读取入口：返回按该租户 `seq` 升序排列的记录列表，每项保留 tenant、seq、event、prev、hash 五个现有字段及其磁盘原值；列表只包含目标租户，其他租户的交错记录既不出现也不改变分页顺序（分页只按目标租户自己的 1..count 计数）。`start_seq` 必须是大于等于 1 的普通整数（拒绝 bool、浮点及其他类型），缺省 1 表示从第一条开始；`page_size` 必须是正的普通整数或 `None`，`None`（缺省）表示读到链尾。起始序号超过当前条数、或末页不足 page_size 都不是错误：返回相应后缀，可能为 `[]`。tenant、start_seq、page_size 在读取任何历史之前全部校验——tenant 沿用与 append/verify/export 相同的标准 JSON 边界，NaN、Infinity、-Infinity、非字符串对象键、循环容器及布尔/其他非标准值统一抛 `ValueError`，非法分页参数同样抛 `ValueError`，且不创建、不修改任何文件。读取在单次只读共享锁快照中完成（与 verify/export 相同）：先以与 `verify(tenant)` 完全相同的 JSON 身份与摘要规则扫描该租户从第一条到链尾的完整历史，整份快照对该租户有效后才在内存中截取所请求页；因此并发追加只能让本次结果对应某次追加之前或之后的完整快照，绝不会出现撕裂页，且即使请求页位于损坏点之前，缺字段、非法 UTF-8 或 JSON、序号不连续、前序摘要不匹配或当前摘要重算不一致都会使整个调用抛出 `AuditChainStateError` 而绝不返回已验证前缀，定位字段（tenant、seq、reason、line）与 verify/append/export_tenant 完全一致，reason 仅为 missing、sequence、digest 并优先报告首次发现的位置。目标租户不存在或日志不存在视为空链，成功返回 `[]`。该入口不写分页缓存、不改动原始字节、不依赖网络；append、append_batch、verify、verify_all、verify_bytes、verify_all_bytes、export_tenant 的签名、返回值、异常边界、并发一致性及可迁移日志格式保持不变。
39	
40	`verify_bytes(data, tenant, expected_count=None)` 与 `verify_all_bytes(data)` 是纯内存离线校验入口：调用方把 JSONL 历史的原始 `bytes` 直接传入（`export_tenant` 导出的单租户字节，或包含交错租户的完整日志均可），入口绝不读取、创建或修改构造器所指向的路径，也不依赖网络、远端锚定或其他服务；结果只依据传入快照，调用期间不修改 `data`。两个入口复用与 verify/verify_all 完全相同的 JSON 标准化、租户身份与摘要算法逐行校验，因此返回结构、reason 分类（missing/sequence/digest）、`at` 口径、租户首次出现顺序与计数与文件入口逐字节一致；空 `bytes` 是成功的空历史（`verify_bytes` 返回 `{"ok": True, "count": 0}`，`verify_all_bytes` 返回 `{"ok": True, "tenants": []}`），且不创建任何文件。空行、非对象、缺字段、重复键、非标准数字（NaN/Infinity/溢出数）、非法 UTF-8 或 JSON 解析失败一律按 missing 处理，能定位的物理行使用行号；seq 不连续为 sequence，prev 或 hash 不符为 digest；其他租户的坏行同样会被发现，且更早的错误优先。`verify_bytes` 的 expected_count 短缺报 missing、超额报 sequence，与 verify 同口径；`data` 不是 `bytes`（含 `bytearray`/`str` 等）、tenant 越过标准 JSON 边界（NaN/Infinity、非字符串键、循环容器等），或 expected_count 不是 `None` 以外的非负整数（`bool` 同样拒绝）时，在任何解析之前抛出 `ValueError`，不泄漏底层解析异常。export_tenant 生成的字节写回另一个 `AuditChain` 后，文件校验与内存校验得到相同的摘要和计数。append、append_batch、verify、verify_all、export_tenant 的签名、格式、错误类型、并发快照及损坏前序拒绝行为保持不变。
41	
42	记录序号 `seq` 的校验是严格的 JSON 整数校验：append 系列只产生从 1 开始连续递增的整数序号，因此历史中每条记录的 `seq` 必须是不带小数和指数表示的 JSON 整数，且恰好等于该租户下一个期望序号。`1.0`、`1e0`、`1E0`、`10e-1` 等浮点拼写（即使宿主语言宽松相等成立）、`true`/`false`、字符串、`null`、数组、对象，以及任何不等于期望值的整数（含负数与零），统一判为 `sequence` 损坏；缺少 `seq` 字段或整行不可解析仍判 `missing`，分类优先级不变。该规则在 append、append_batch、append_if_head、append_batch_if_head、append_many、append_many_if_heads、import_tenant、verify、verify_all、head、heads、read_tenant、export_tenant、verify_bytes、verify_all_bytes 全部公开入口一致生效，文件扫描与内存扫描对同一损坏行给出相同结论：`sequence` 错误把期望序号、租户与物理行号填入 `AuditChainStateError`（verify 系结果继续使用现有 `ok`/`at`/`tenant`/`reason` 结构），物理顺序上更早的 missing/sequence/digest 优先，`expected_count` 对合法历史的短缺/超额语义不变。非法序号不会被重编号、跳过、重写或当作另一租户：任何写入入口遇到该状态都拒绝追加且保持原字节不变，`import_tenant` 对含非法序号的输入或目标同样整体失败、不留部分导入；非法调用参数仍在读取历史之前以 `ValueError` 结束。
43	`export_tenant_chunks(tenant, chunk_size)` 与 `export_all_chunks(chunk_size)` 是面向大历史的分块离线导出入口，分别是 `export_tenant`/`export_all` 的分块版本：不创建、不改写、不删除任何文件，不访问网络，也不写额外落盘元数据。两者都返回一个产生 `bytes` 的迭代器，按顺序产出的分块拼接后分别与同一份快照上 `export_tenant(tenant)`、`export_all()` 的返回值**逐字节相等**；分块只按字节偏移切分，可切在任意 UTF-8 序列、JSON 对象或换行中间，最后一块可以更短，空历史（日志不存在、为空，或目标租户无记录）产出空迭代（零个分块）。tenant 沿用与 append/verify/export 完全相同的标准 JSON 边界；`chunk_size` 必须是正的普通整数（`bool` 即使是 int 子类也拒绝，`0`、负数、浮点、字符串及其他类型一律 `ValueError`），所有边界错误在产生迭代器或读取历史之前抛出。整次导出固定于一个完整快照：在同一次只读共享锁快照上先完成与对应非分块入口完全相同的全链校验（单租户即 `verify(tenant)` 的扫描，全日志即 `verify_all` 的物理顺序扫描），**首块产生之前**校验必须全部通过；源历史损坏时不产出任何分块，改抛 `AuditChainStateError`，其 tenant、seq、reason、line 与 `export_tenant`/`export_all` 完全一致，并发追加只能让各次导出对应某次追加之前或之后的完整快照。
44	
45	`import_tenant_chunks(tenant, chunks)` 与 `import_all_chunks(chunks)` 是对应的分块离线导入入口，分别是 `import_tenant`/`import_all` 的大历史版本：调用方按顺序提供一个 `bytes` 分块可迭代对象，单个 `bytes` 或 `bytearray` 不能被当作容器（其迭代会产出整数，统一 `ValueError`），不可迭代容器或任何非 `bytes`（`bytearray` 元素同样拒绝）成员也是 `ValueError`，遇到首个坏成员立即停止消费后续分块；空分块允许，空可迭代或仅含空分块等价于空内容。分块只按字节拼接，可切在任意字节位置（UTF-8、JSON、换行中间），只有按序拼接后的整段才被解析。二者分别接受现有 `import_tenant`、`import_all` 可接受的完整内容，字段、优先级与字节入口完全一致：`import_tenant_chunks` 的 tenant 沿用标准 JSON 边界，混入其他规范 JSON 身份租户抛 `ValueError`；非法 JSONL、缺字段、顺序或摘要错误抛带输入物理行号的 `AuditChainStateError`，目标涉及租户已有记录抛 `AuditChainConflictError`（固定空链期望、actual_* 反映租约内尾部），且一切输入问题严格优先于目标状态。空拼接在边界校验通过后返回 `[]`，不创建文件、不读取历史、不改字节。成功时按物理顺序返回与对应字节入口**相同的记录对象**（保留 tenant/seq/event/prev/hash 原值），并把整段内容作为**一次不可分提交**写入（末行缺换行沿用 append 的补换行规则）；任何输入或目标失败都不写入部分字节，持共享锁的并发读取者只能看到提交前或提交后的完整状态，竞争同一空链头的分块导入在同一排他租约上串行、恰有一个获胜。新接口不依赖网络、远端锚定或额外落盘元数据；所有既有追加、条件头、分页读取、verify 系列、范围迁移及非分块导入导出的行为、签名、返回值、异常字段、租户隔离与规范 JSONL 字节格式保持不变。
46

# Audit Chain

A dependency-free Python reference implementation for security, audit, transaction-graph.

Run with: python3 demo.py
Tests: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v

## Scope

实现按租户分区的追加审计日志：每条记录包含租户、顺序号、事件和前一条摘要，读取方可以离线校验完整历史并定位第一个损坏的位置。追加必须拒绝错误的前序状态，校验结果要明确区分缺失、顺序错误和摘要错误；日志格式保持可迁移，不依赖网络服务或远端锚定。

租户身份按稳定的 JSON 数据身份划分（`json.dumps(..., sort_keys=True)`）：对象键顺序不影响身份，而 `1`、`1.0`、`true`、`"1"` 是四个互不相干的租户；append、verify、verify_all 共用同一套分区语义。

输入与读取都遵循标准 JSON 边界：append 的 tenant 和 event 只能由 null、布尔值、有限整数/浮点数、字符串、数组和键为字符串的对象递归组成，NaN、Infinity、-Infinity、非字符串键及无法无歧义编码的值一律抛出 `ValueError`（先于任何追加动作，不写入任何字节）。verify 的 tenant 参数采用同一定义：非法值在读取历史或触碰路径之前抛出 `ValueError`（不泄露 TypeError/RecursionError 或 JSON 编码异常），已损坏的文件与非法 tenant 同时出现时同样是 `ValueError` 优先且字节不变；合法 tenant 的校验结果（missing/sequence/digest 及 expected_count 语义）保持不变。verify/verify_all 以同一规则解释历史：包含重复对象键、NaN/Infinity/-Infinity 或其他非标准 JSON 内容的物理行按 missing 类损坏处理并停在首次出现处。

同一路径可被多个线程或进程同时读写而仍保持单一可验证历史：append 在整个"读取最新状态—计算 seq/prev/hash—追加"区间持有排他文件锁（`flock`，无第三方依赖），因此每条记录都基于其真正落盘前的最新完整状态计算，任何调用都不会覆盖既有字节；verify/verify_all 持共享锁读取，只会看到某次追加之前或之后完整自洽的文件视图，绝不会把写了一半的记录报成损坏。历史一旦损坏，并发 append 仍以相同的 tenant/seq/line/reason（missing、sequence、digest 之一）抛出 `AuditChainStateError` 且不改动文件。旧版 JSONL 文件格式不变，可继续直接验证。

`append_batch(tenant, events)` 一次提交一组同租户事件：events 必须是列表（空列表直接返回 `[]`，不创建文件、不改动字节；其他类型一律 `ValueError`），租户与列表中每个事件沿用与 append 相同的标准 JSON 边界。成功时按输入顺序分配连续 seq——首条接在该租户当前链末（prev 为提交前最后一条记录的摘要），后续逐条引用批次内前一条摘要——并在同一次排他租约内以一个字节块整体追加，因此整批对其他追加/校验是一个不可分割的可见结果：同租户追加只能整体落在批前或批后，不同租户仍可交错且各自从 1 计数。落盘为每行一个 JSON 对象，与逐条调用 append 产生的字节和 verify/verify_all 计数、摘要、首个错误位置完全一致；扫描到与 append 相同的首个损坏点时抛出同样字段（tenant、seq、reason、line）的 `AuditChainStateError`，失败不留任何部分记录。

`append_if_head(tenant, event, expected_count, expected_hash)` 是带前序断言的单条条件追加：调用方给出链头应有的记录数和末条摘要，只有二者与租约内实际读到的链头**同时**相等时才追加下一条。`expected_count` 必须是非负普通整数（`bool`、负数、浮点、字符串、`None` 及其他类型一律 `ValueError`），`expected_hash` 必须恰好是 64 个小写十六进制字符（长度不符、大写、非 hex 字符或非字符串一律 `ValueError`），空链的期望摘要使用现有 `ZERO`。tenant、event 继续沿用与 append 完全相同的标准 JSON 边界；所有非法值（含布尔计数、负数计数、格式不正确的摘要）都在读取日志或创建文件之前以 `ValueError` 结束，不创建、不修改日志。成功时返回值与 append 完全相同（同一记录 dict、同样的五个字段、seq、prev 与摘要算法），落盘字节与对相同历史调用 append 逐字节一致。断言格式合法但与当前链头不符时抛出新增的 `AuditChainConflictError`，公开 `tenant`、`expected_count`、`expected_hash`、`actual_count`、`actual_hash` 五个字段，且 `reason` 固定为 `"conflict"`；`actual_count` 为零时 `actual_hash` 为 `ZERO`，历史为空（日志不存在、为空或只含其他租户记录）时按同一规则比较，失败调用不写入任何字节——对尚不存在的日志作出非空断言尤其不会创建日志文件。历史损坏时沿用 `AuditChainStateError`：tenant、seq、line、reason 语义与 append/verify/export 完全一致，reason 仍只取 missing、sequence、digest，错误优先级与文件字节不变，且状态错误优先于冲突判定（不会拿不可验证的链去比较断言）。校验、比较与写入在同一次排他租约内完成：日志已存在时使用与 append 相同的数据文件排他锁；日志尚不存在时，排他目录取锁（普通 append 创建文件时同样短暂持有该锁）覆盖"探测不存在—空链比较—创建文件"整段，且文件只在断言获胜后才被创建，加锁顺序始终是目录锁先于文件锁，不会与普通 append 死锁。因此并发提交同一个链头时至多一个成功，其余调用都在锁内观察到获胜者写入的新链头并得到确定的冲突异常（actual_* 反映获胜后的真实计数与末条摘要）。append、append_batch、verify、verify_all、verify_bytes、verify_all_bytes、export_tenant、read_tenant 的签名、结果、JSONL 格式、租户身份区分及离线行为保持不变。

`append_batch_if_head(tenant, events, expected_count, expected_hash)` 把批量追加与头部断言合并为一次原子提交：events 必须是列表（其他类型一律 `ValueError`；空列表在全部参数校验通过后直接返回 `[]`，不创建文件、不读写任何字节，头部断言不被求值），tenant 与每个事件沿用与 append 相同的标准 JSON 边界，`expected_count`/`expected_hash` 的边界与 append_if_head 完全一致（非负普通整数、拒绝 bool；恰好 64 个小写十六进制字符，空链用 `ZERO`），所有非法值都在读取历史或触碰路径之前统一抛 `ValueError`。events 非空时，扫描、比较与写入在同一次排他租约内完成：先以与 append 完全相同的规则校验该租户从第一条到链尾的完整链，再同时比较实际记录数与末条摘要，二者都匹配才追加。成功时返回按 seq 排列的记录 dict 列表（tenant、seq、event、prev、hash 五字段），首条 seq 为 `expected_count + 1`、prev 为 `expected_hash`，后续记录在批次内部连续链接，整批作为一个不可分割的字节区间一次落盘——其他租户的追加只能整体落在批前或批后，持共享锁的读取方只能看到提交前或提交后的完整快照；落盘字节与对同一链头逐条调用 append（或一次 append_batch）得到的历史逐字节一致。日志尚不存在时只有 `(0, ZERO)` 断言的非空批次可以创建文件，其余非空断言抛 `AuditChainConflictError`（actual 为 `(0, ZERO)`）且不创建文件；已存在日志上的头部不匹配同样抛 `AuditChainConflictError`，公开 `tenant`、`expected_count`、`expected_hash`、`actual_count`、`actual_hash`，`reason` 固定为 `"conflict"`。扫描发现缺失、顺序错误或摘要错误时优先抛 `AuditChainStateError`（tenant、seq、reason、物理行号语义与 append 一致，状态错误优先于冲突判定）；冲突与状态错误路径都不写入任何部分记录。并发调用共享同一链头时至多一个批次成功，其余调用在锁内观察到获胜批次之后的新链头并得到携带实际值的冲突异常。功能不依赖网络或远端锚定；append、append_batch、append_if_head、verify、verify_all、verify_bytes、verify_all_bytes、export_tenant、read_tenant 的签名、结果与异常边界保持不变。

`append_many(entries)` 是跨租户的原子追加入口：entries 必须是列表，每项必须是**恰好**含 `tenant`、`event` 两个键的对象（参数不是列表、成员不是对象、缺键、多键或键集合不符一律 `ValueError`；非字符串成员键同样拒绝），列表顺序就是记录的写入顺序。每个 tenant 与 event 沿用与 append 完全相同的标准 JSON 边界；列表形状、成员形状、键集合以及全部 tenant/event 在触碰路径、读取历史或加锁之前完成校验，任何边界错误都统一为 `ValueError` 且不创建文件、不读写字节（即使目标日志已损坏也不读取）。空列表在参数校验通过后直接返回 `[]`：不创建、不读取也不改变日志。非空调用在一次排他租约内读取一致快照，对本次涉及的每个租户执行与 append 完全相同的完整链扫描——序号从 1 起连续、prev 与当前链头衔接、每条 hash 可重算——缺失/无法解析为 `missing`、顺序错误为 `sequence`、prev 或 hash 不一致为 `digest`，抛出字段（tenant、seq、reason、物理行号）与 append 完全一致的 `AuditChainStateError`；多个受影响链同时有问题时，按日志中首次出现的物理行确定结果，物理行相同再按输入的首次出现顺序确定；任何校验失败都不写入部分记录、字节保持不变，未涉及租户自身的损坏不阻止本次提交。全部前序状态有效后，同一租户在列表中可出现多次，其记录按出现顺序连续编号（首条接该租户提交前的链尾，后续逐条引用本组内前一条摘要），其他租户各自从当前链尾继续；返回与输入一一对应的记录 dict 列表，每项保留 tenant、seq、event、prev、hash 五个字段，物理 JSONL 顺序与输入顺序一致，摘要与前序摘要规则、序列化（`sort_keys=True`、`allow_nan=False`）与换行补全规则与 append 完全相同——落盘字节与按输入顺序逐条调用 append 逐字节一致。全部生成记录作为一个不可分割的追加区块一次写入：持共享锁的并发读取只能看到提交前或提交后的完整快照，竞争写入在同一租约上串行、整体落在区块之前或之后且不会覆盖既有字节，其他租户的合法交错记录继续保留；目标文件不存在时仅在校验成功后才创建。生成的日志可由现有 verify、verify_all、verify_bytes、verify_all_bytes、read_tenant、export_tenant 与离线字节校验直接验证，import_tenant 的既有空链冲突语义保持不变。功能不依赖网络或远端锚定；JSONL 字段、租户身份区分、摘要算法、错误类型与既有入口的签名、返回值及行为保持兼容。

`append_many_if_heads(entries)` 把跨租户原子追加与每租户链头断言合并为一次离线原子提交，相当于 `append_many` 的不可分割分组提交与每租户一个 `append_batch_if_head` 式头部断言的融合：entries 必须是列表，每项必须是**恰好**含 `tenant`、`events`、`expected_count`、`expected_hash` 四个键的对象（参数不是列表、成员不是对象、缺键、多键或键集合不符一律 `ValueError`；非字符串成员键同样拒绝）；events 必须是非空列表（非列表或空列表一律 `ValueError`——空 `entries` 列表才是校验通过后的空操作），其每个事件沿用与 append 完全相同的标准 JSON 边界；`expected_count` 必须是非负普通整数（`bool` 即使是 int 子类也拒绝，负数、浮点、字符串、`None` 及其他类型一律 `ValueError`），`expected_hash` 必须恰好是 64 个小写十六进制字符（长度不符、大写、非 hex 字符或非字符串一律 `ValueError`），空链断言使用现有 `ZERO`；同一规范 JSON 身份的 tenant 在整个 entries 中至多出现一次，重复（含仅对象键顺序不同但身份相同）一律 `ValueError`，而 `1`、`1.0`、`true`、`"1"` 等不同 JSON 身份仍是互不相关的租户。列表形状、成员形状、键集合、events 非空、计数/摘要格式、租户唯一性以及全部 tenant/event 的标准 JSON 边界都在加锁、探测路径或读取任何字节之前完成，任何非法输入统一抛 `ValueError` 且不创建文件、不读写字节，即使目标日志已损坏也不读取。空列表在全部校验通过后直接返回 `[]`：不创建、不读取也不改变日志，头部断言不被求值。非空调用在一次排他租约内读取一致快照，只对本次涉及的每个租户执行与 append 完全相同的完整链扫描——只验证涉及租户从 seq=1 到链尾的顺序、prev 与每条 hash，缺失或无法解析为 `missing`、序号错误为 `sequence`、前序或当前摘要不符为 `digest`，并以 `AuditChainStateError` 的 tenant、seq、line、reason 字段报告；多个涉及链同时损坏时按物理行号优先、输入首次出现顺序打破平局（与 append_many 完全一致），未涉及租户的损坏忽略。任何状态错误都不拿不可验证的链去比较断言、不写入任何字节。涉及链状态全部有效后，按 entries 顺序依次比较每个断言的计数与末条摘要，首个不符项（无论租户）按 entries 顺序抛 `AuditChainConflictError`，公开该租户的 `expected_count`、`expected_hash`、`actual_count`、`actual_hash`，`reason` 固定为 `"conflict"`，`actual_count` 为零时 `actual_hash` 为 `ZERO`；状态错误严格优先于冲突，冲突路径同样不写入任何字节。日志不存在时，只有**全部**断言都是 `(0, ZERO)` 才能创建文件；否则按 entries 顺序首个非空/错摘要断言在目录租约内确定性地抛出 actual 为 `(0, ZERO)` 的冲突，且不创建任何文件。全部断言匹配时，按 entries 顺序、每个 entry 内按 events 顺序生成并返回五字段记录（tenant、seq、event、prev、hash）列表：每个租户从其断言链尾（首条 prev 为 `expected_hash`）连续编号，同一 entry 的多条事件在批次内连续链接，字段、摘要算法、规范化序列化（`sort_keys=True`、`allow_nan=False`）、末行缺换行时补换行及租户身份规则与 append_batch、append_many 完全一致，落盘字节与对相同链头按相同 entry/event 顺序逐条调用 append 逐字节一致；所有记录作为不可分割 JSONL 区块一次追加，其他租户的合法交错记录继续保留。并发提交在同一排他租约上串行：竞争相同/相交链头的调用至多一个成功，其余在锁内观察到获胜者写入后的新链头并得到携带获胜后实际计数与末条摘要的确定冲突，持共享锁的读取方只能看到提交前或提交后的完整快照，绝不会看到半个区块。生成的日志可由 append、append_batch、append_if_head、append_batch_if_head、append_many、verify、verify_all、verify_bytes、verify_all_bytes、read_tenant、export_tenant/import_tenant 直接继续追加、校验、分页读取与离线迁移；功能不依赖网络或远端锚定，既有入口的签名、返回值、异常字段与可迁移 JSONL 格式保持兼容。

`export_tenant(tenant)` 面向离线迁移，按租户导出单链：返回 UTF-8 编码的 `bytes`，本身不创建、不改写、不删除任何文件，也不访问网络；调用方自行把返回字节写入新的 JSONL 路径后，新的 `AuditChain` 可直接用现有 verify/verify_all 离线验证。tenant 采用与 append/verify 完全相同的标准 JSON 边界，非法值在读取任何历史之前统一抛 `ValueError` 且不读取、不创建文件。导出在单次只读共享锁快照中完成：先运行与 `verify(tenant)` 相同的完整扫描，整份快照对该租户有效后才开始拼装结果，因此源状态错误统一抛 `AuditChainStateError`（填入目标 tenant、首个应检查的 seq、reason 与物理行号），绝不会先返回已收集的前缀；reason 仅为 missing、sequence、digest，优先级与行号沿用现有校验规则。源文件不存在或为空是合法空快照，成功返回 `b""`。导出内容只包含目标租户在源文件中按物理顺序出现的记录（其他租户的交错记录被丢弃且不导致重排），每行一个 JSON 对象，沿用 append 的序列化（`sort_keys=True`、`allow_nan=False`）与换行规则，字段、值、seq、prev、hash 与源历史语义一致；JSON 身份不同的租户（如 `1`、`1.0`、`true`、`"1"`）各自独立导出、互不混入。快照未变更时重复调用得到字节完全相同的结果；并发追加期间，导出只能观察到某次追加之前或之后的完整快照，失败时不写入任何字节。

`import_tenant(tenant, data)` 是 `export_tenant` 的离线反向入口：把一段单租户 JSONL 历史（通常来自另一条日志的导出字节）整体移植/灾备恢复到本日志，全程不依赖网络或远端锚定。调用先于任何历史读取、路径探测和加锁完成参数边界校验：tenant 沿用与 append/verify/export 完全相同的标准 JSON 边界（NaN/Infinity、非字符串键、循环容器及无标准 JSON 编码的值一律 `ValueError`），`data` 必须是 `bytes`（`str`、`bytearray` 及其他类型一律 `ValueError`），参数边界错误优先于一切历史状态处理，且不创建文件、不改字节。`data` 为空 `b""` 时在校验通过后直接返回 `[]`：不创建文件、不读取历史、不改变任何字节（即使目标日志已损坏也不读取）。非空 `data` 必须是严格 UTF-8、每行一个标准 JSON 对象的单租户历史；在触碰目标之前先完整校验整条输入链——从 `seq=1`、`prev=ZERO` 起逐行确认必需字段、连续顺序与摘要：解析失败、重复键、非标准数字、非法 UTF-8 或缺字段抛 `AuditChainStateError`、reason 为 `missing`，顺序错误为 `sequence`，prev 或 hash 不一致为 `digest`，并准确填充 tenant、seq 与物理行号（行号与优先级规则与 append/verify/export 完全一致）；混入任何其他规范 JSON 身份的租户记录（含交错的其他租户、`1` 与 `"1"` 这类不同身份）违反单租户输入契约，统一抛 `ValueError`。随后在同一次受保护操作（与 append 相同的数据文件排他租约；目标不存在时经目录租约原子创建）内校验目标文件：目标租户已有任何记录即抛 `AuditChainConflictError`，固定 `expected_count=0`、`expected_hash=ZERO`，`actual_count`/`actual_hash` 反映租约内观察到的目标尾部（含其他租户交错后的该租户真实尾摘要）；目标历史损坏时优先返回与 append 完全相同的 `AuditChainStateError`（状态错误优先于冲突判定），其他租户自身的摘要损坏不影响导入。任何失败路径都不写入部分记录、不改变既有字节。成功时把整段历史作为一个不可分割的字节块一次追加（目标最后一行缺换行时沿用 append 的补换行规则），记录原有的 tenant、seq、event、prev、hash 原样保留——既不重编号也不重算摘要，首条仍以 `ZERO` 为锚；返回按 seq 排列的记录 dict 列表（恰含五个现有字段及其输入原值）。目标文件可已包含其他租户的有效交错记录，导入后 verify、verify_all、verify_bytes、verify_all_bytes、export_tenant、read_tenant 均按现有规则通过，且该租户可直接用 append/append_if_head 从导入尾部继续；JSON 身份不同的租户互不可见、互不冲突。并发导入/追加同租户时，写操作在同一排他租约上串行：至多一次导入成功提交完整区块，其余调用要么观察到该租户非空链头而得到携带实际尾部的冲突，要么在导入之前成功并让随后的导入冲突；共享锁读取方只能看到整段导入之前或之后的完整快照。append、append_batch、append_if_head、append_batch_if_head、verify、verify_all、verify_bytes、verify_all_bytes、export_tenant、read_tenant 的签名、返回值、异常字段、租户身份区分、并发快照与 JSONL 可迁移格式保持不变。

`export_all()` 与 `import_all(data)` 是整份日志快照的离线迁移入口，分别对应 export_tenant/import_tenant 的全日志版本，JSONL 格式、摘要算法、租户身份规则与既有入口完全不变。`export_all()` 只读返回当前日志的 UTF-8 `bytes`：不创建、不改写、不删除任何文件，不访问网络；日志不存在或为空是合法空快照，返回 `b""`。返回前在同一次只读共享锁快照上按物理顺序验证所有租户的全部链（每个租户自首次出现起独立从 seq=1、prev=ZERO 校验，规则与 verify_all 一致）：物理行无法按严格 UTF-8 和标准 JSON 解析、含重复键或非标准数字，或任一租户出现缺字段、顺序错误、前序摘要错误或当前摘要错误时，不返回任何部分结果，改抛 `AuditChainStateError`（reason 仅为 missing、sequence、digest），以 tenant、seq、reason、line 定位物理顺序上的首次损坏——无法确定租户的行（不可解析、非对象、无 tenant 键）tenant 与 seq 为 None。验证通过后逐字节返回快照原文（含租户交错顺序），并发追加期间导出只能对应完整的追加前或追加后视图。`import_all(data)` 接收多租户交错的 JSONL 字节：`data` 不是 `bytes` 时在读取目标之前抛 `ValueError`；空 `bytes` 在类型检查通过后返回 `[]`，不创建文件、不读历史、不改字节。非空输入先在内存中完整验证：允许租户交错，但每个租户的链都从 seq=1、prev=ZERO 起连续，每条记录恰含 tenant、seq、event、prev、hash 五个既有字段且摘要可重算；解析失败、缺字段或多字段、重复键、非标准数字、非法 UTF-8 按 missing，序号问题按 sequence，prev 或 hash 不符按 digest，均抛带输入物理行号的 `AuditChainStateError`，物理顺序上首个损坏行决定结果。输入验证通过后，目标检查与提交在同一次排他租约内作为一次原子操作完成，且只检查输入涉及的租户：目标链损坏优先抛与 append 相同字段的 `AuditChainStateError`（多链同时损坏按目标物理行优先、输入首次出现顺序打破平局）；涉及租户已有记录时按输入首次出现顺序抛 `AuditChainConflictError`，`expected_count` 固定为 0、`expected_hash` 固定为 `ZERO`，`actual_count`/`actual_hash` 反映租约内观察到的该租户尾部；任何失败路径都不写入字节。全部涉及链为空时，才把规范化 JSONL（`sort_keys=True`、`allow_nan=False`，每行一条记录）作为一个不可分割区块一次追加，目标末行缺换行时沿用 append 的补换行规则，目标不存在时仅在校验通过后创建；成功返回按输入物理顺序排列、保留原值的记录 dict 列表。竞争导入或追加在同一租约上串行，共享锁读取方只能看到完整提交前或提交后的状态。append、append_batch、append_if_head、append_batch_if_head、append_many、append_many_if_heads、verify、verify_all、verify_bytes、verify_all_bytes、export_tenant、import_tenant、read_tenant、head、heads 的签名、返回值、异常字段与既有语义保持不变。

`export_tenant_range(tenant, start_seq, end_seq=None)` 与 `import_tenant_range(tenant, data, expected_count, expected_hash)` 是非空链的分段迁移入口：归档或灾备恢复可以从一个已知链头继续，而不必每次搬运整份历史；五字段记录、seq 编号与摘要算法与既有入口完全一致。`export_tenant_range` 只读返回目标租户闭区间 `[start_seq, end_seq]` 的 UTF-8 JSONL `bytes`（`end_seq=None` 表示到链尾），不创建、不改写、不删除任何文件，不访问网络；记录原样保留磁盘上的 prev 与 hash，因此首条记录的 prev 仍指向被省略的前序链头。tenant 沿用与 append/verify/export 相同的标准 JSON 边界，`start_seq` 必须是正的普通整数（拒绝 bool、浮点及其他类型），`end_seq` 必须是 `None` 或不小于 `start_seq` 的普通整数，非法边界在读取任何历史之前抛 `ValueError`。导出在单次只读共享锁快照中先以与 `verify(tenant)` 完全相同的规则完整校验该租户整条链——源历史损坏抛与 append/verify/export_tenant 相同字段的 `AuditChainStateError`，即使请求区间完全位于损坏点之前也绝不返回已验证前缀——校验通过后才在内存中截取闭区间。空链（日志不存在、为空或该租户无记录）或范围超出链尾（`start_seq` 大于当前条数，或显式 `end_seq` 大于当前条数）抛新增的 `AuditChainRangeError`，公开 `tenant`、`start_seq`、`end_seq`（按调用原值，未给 `end_seq` 时为 `None`）、`count`（快照内验证过的链长），`reason` 固定为 `"range"`，且不返回任何字节。`import_tenant_range` 是反向入口：先校验参数——tenant 标准 JSON 边界、`data` 只能是 `bytes`、`expected_count` 必须是非负普通整数（拒绝 bool）、`expected_hash` 必须恰好是 64 个小写十六进制字符（空链断言用 `ZERO`）——非法值在读取前抛 `ValueError`；空 `bytes` 在校验通过后返回 `[]`，不创建文件、不读历史、不改字节。非空输入在触碰目标之前完整校验：严格 UTF-8 JSONL、每条物理行都是同一规范 JSON 身份租户且**恰好**含五个既有字段（多字段同样按 missing 处理）、seq 从 `expected_count + 1` 起连续递增、第一条 prev 等于 `expected_hash`、每条 hash 可重算；缺失/顺序/摘要错误分别以 `missing`/`sequence`/`digest` 报告首个物理行（`AuditChainStateError`，tenant/seq/line 填充规则与 append 一致），混入其他租户身份违反单租户输入契约抛 `ValueError`。随后在原子提交中（与 append_if_head 相同的租约：已存在日志用数据文件排他锁，不存在时目录租约覆盖"探测—空链比较—创建"整段）先以与 append 完全相同的规则校验目标完整链——目标损坏优先抛 `AuditChainStateError`——再同时比较实际 count 与末条 hash，二者都与断言匹配才把整段作为一个不可分割字节块追加（末行缺换行时沿用 append 的补换行规则）并返回按 seq 排列的记录 dict 列表；断言不符抛带 `actual_count`、`actual_hash` 的 `AuditChainConflictError`（`reason` 固定 `"conflict"`），目标不存在时只有 `(0, ZERO)` 断言可创建文件，其余非空断言确定性冲突且不创建文件；任何失败路径都不写入字节。并发提交在同一租约上串行：至多一个获胜，其余在锁内观察到获胜后的真实链头并得到携带实际值的冲突。既有入口（append 系列、verify 系列、export_tenant/export_all/import_tenant/import_all、read_tenant、head/heads）的签名、返回值、异常字段、并发快照与可迁移 JSONL 格式保持不变。

`import_all_range(data, expected_heads)` 是多租户分段迁移入口：把多个租户从各自已知链头开始的 JSONL 片段（通常由若干次 export_tenant_range 产生，允许租户交错）在一次离线原子提交中追加到本日志，是 import_tenant_range 的跨租户版本，也是 import_all 从已知头部续写而非空链嫁接的推广。记录原样保留 tenant、seq、event、prev、hash——既不重编号也不重算摘要——因此 verify/verify_all/verify_bytes/verify_all_bytes 与 export 系列按既有规则即可校验合并后的日志。参数边界先于一切：`data` 必须是 `bytes`（`str`、`bytearray` 及其他类型一律 `ValueError`），`expected_heads` 必须是列表（其他类型一律 `ValueError`），每个成员必须是**恰好**含 `tenant`、`expected_count`、`expected_hash` 三个键的对象（缺键、多键、键集合不符或非字符串成员键同样拒绝）；tenant 沿用与 append/verify/export 完全相同的标准 JSON 边界，`expected_count` 必须是非负普通整数（`bool` 即使是 int 子类也拒绝，负数、浮点、字符串、`None` 及其他类型一律 `ValueError`），`expected_hash` 必须恰好是 64 个小写十六进制字符（空链断言用现有 `ZERO`）；同一规范 JSON 身份的 tenant 在整个 expected_heads 中至多出现一次（仅对象键顺序不同但身份相同同样 `ValueError`），而 `1`、`1.0`、`true`、`"1"` 仍是互不相干的租户。所有形状、键集合、租户/计数/摘要格式与唯一性校验都在加锁、探测路径或读取任何字节之前完成，任何非法输入统一抛 `ValueError` 且不创建文件、不读写字节，即使目标日志已损坏也不读取。`data` 为空 `b""` 时在全部参数校验通过后直接返回 `[]`：不创建文件、不读取历史、不改变任何字节，头部断言不被求值。非空输入在触碰目标之前先在内存中完整校验：严格 UTF-8 JSONL，输入允许租户交错，但每租户首条 `seq=expected_count+1`、`prev=expected_hash`，之后连续递增；每条物理行必须是恰含 tenant、seq、event、prev、hash 五个既有字段的对象，且每条 hash 按现有算法可重算；每个被列出的租户至少出现一条记录。解析失败、重复键、非标准数字、空行、非对象、缺字段或多字段、非法 UTF-8、以及缺记录的已列出租户抛 `AuditChainStateError`、reason 为 `missing`；序号问题为 `sequence`；prev/hash 不符为 `digest`；异常携带 tenant、seq、line（输入物理行号），无法确定租户时 tenant 与 seq 为 `None`；出现未列入 expected_heads 的其他规范 JSON 身份租户记录违反输入契约，按物理行首个决定的优先级抛 `ValueError`（与 import_tenant 的外来租户规则一致）；多处问题按物理行首个决定（输入问题整体优先于目标状态），输入校验失败不读取目标、不写入任何字节。随后目标扫描、断言比较与写入在同一次排他租约内完成（与 append_many_if_heads 相同的租约：已存在日志用数据文件排他锁，日志不存在时目录租约覆盖"探测—空链比较—创建"整段）：只扫描本次涉及租户的目标链，未涉及租户的损坏忽略；目标损坏优先抛与 append 字段相同的 `AuditChainStateError`（多链同时损坏按目标物理行号优先、expected_heads 顺序打破平局），绝不拿不可验证的链去比较断言。涉及链全部有效后，按 expected_heads 顺序依次比较 count 与末条 hash，首个不符项抛 `AuditChainConflictError`，公开该租户的 `expected_count`、`expected_hash`、`actual_count`、`actual_hash`，`reason` 固定为 `"conflict"`，`actual_count` 为零时 `actual_hash` 为 `ZERO`；冲突路径不写入任何字节。目标不存在时只有**全部**断言都是 `(0, ZERO)` 才能创建文件，否则按列表顺序首个非空/错摘要断言确定性地以 actual `(0, ZERO)` 冲突返回且不留任何文件。成功时按输入物理顺序返回保留原值的记录 dict 列表，以现有规范 @staticmethod
    def _decode_lines(data):
        # Split the raw JSONL bytes into physical lines while treating the
        # first illegal UTF-8 byte as a hard, locatable stop point.
        # Returns (lines, bad_line): lines are the complete physical lines
        # preceding any corruption (all lines when the file is valid UTF-8),
        # bad_line is the 1-based line number of the first undecodable line
        # or None. A bad line is never yielded, even if the bytes before the
        # illegal byte looked like complete JSON: callers scan the preceding
        # complete lines first, so an earlier JSON/sequence/digest error
        # still takes priority.
        try:
            return data.decode("utf-8").splitlines(), None
        except UnicodeDecodeError as exc:
            # start is the offset of the first byte that cannot be decoded;
            # everything before it is a valid UTF-8 prefix.
            start = exc.start
        bad_line = data.count(b"\n", 0, start) + 1
        cut = data.rfind(b"\n", 0, start) + 1  # start of the bad line
        return data[:cut].decode("utf-8").splitlines(), bad_line

@staticmethod
    def _split_lf(text):
        # Physical lines are bounded by exactly one character: the byte 0x0A
        # (LF), so a CRLF sequence is still one line -- the trailing CR stays
        # attached to its line and strict JSON accepts it as line-ending
        # whitespace. No other character ends a record: U+0085, U+2028,
        # U+2029 and a bare CR are valid UTF-8 content of the current line
        # and are handed to strict JSON (which keeps the three Unicode
        # separators as ordinary string content and rejects a raw CR inside
        # a JSON string). str.splitlines() must never be used here: it treats
        # all of those as line boundaries. The input is non-empty and, for a
        # trailing-LF text, the single empty segment after the final LF is
        # dropped (matching a physical record count: every LF terminates one
        # line, it does not begin an extra empty one).
        lines = text.split("\n")
        if text.endswith("\n"):
            lines.pop()
        return lines

    @classmethod
    def _decode_lines(cls, data):
        # Split the raw JSONL bytes into LF-bounded physical lines while
        # treating the first illegal UTF-8 byte as a hard, locatable stop
        # point. Returns (lines, bad_line): lines are the complete physical
        # lines preceding any corruption (all lines when the bytes are valid
        # UTF-8), bad_line is the 1-based LF physical line number of the
        # first undecodable line or None. A bad line is never yielded, even
        # if the bytes before the illegal byte looked like complete JSON:
        # callers scan the preceding complete lines first, so an earlier
        # JSON/sequence/digest error still takes priority. Empty bytes are
        # zero physical lines, not one blank one.
        if not data:
            return [], None
        try:
            return cls._split_lf(data.decode("utf-8")), None
        except UnicodeDecodeError as exc:
            # start is the offset of the first byte that cannot be decoded;
            # everything before it is a valid UTF-8 prefix. Physical lines
            # count LF bytes only, so the bad line's number is one plus the
            # number of LFs before that offset.

@staticmethod
    def _split_lf(text):
        # Physical lines are bounded by exactly one character: the byte 0x0A
        # (LF), so a CRLF sequence is still one line -- the trailing CR stays
        # attached to its line and strict JSON accepts it as line-ending
        # whitespace. No other character ends a record: U+0085, U+2028,
        # U+2029 and a bare CR are valid UTF-8 content of the current line
        # and are handed to strict JSON (which keeps the three Unicode
        # separators as ordinary string content and rejects a raw CR inside
        # a JSON string). str.splitlines() must never be used here: it treats
        # all of those as line boundaries. The input is non-empty and, for a
        # trailing-LF text, the single empty segment after the final LF is
        # dropped (matching a physical record count: every LF terminates one
        # line, it does not begin an extra empty one).
        lines = text.split("\n")
        if text.endswith("\n"):
            lines.pop()
        return lines

    @classmethod
    def _decode_lines(cls, data):
        # Split the raw JSONL bytes into LF-bounded physical lines while
        # treating the first illegal UTF-8 byte as a hard, locatable stop
        # point. Returns (lines, bad_line): lines are the complete physical
        # lines preceding any corruption (all lines when the bytes are valid

        # JSON/sequence/digest error still takes priority. Empty bytes are
        # zero physical lines, not one blank one.
        if not data:
            return [], None
        try:
            return cls._split_lf(data.decode("utf-8")), None

            start = exc.start

"""Acceptance tests for the LF-only physical line boundary.

Only the byte 0x0A terminates a JSONL record; a CR immediately before it
(CRLF) is still one line. U+0085, U+2028, U+2029 and a bare CR are not line
boundaries: the Unicode separators stay on the current line as ordinary
strict-JSON string content (tenant values, events, object keys, arrays and
nested values), while a bare CR in a spot strict JSON forbids must surface as
a parse failure. Every entry point shares that one boundary, and physical
line numbers count LFs.
"""
import json
import os
import unittest
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from pathlib import Path

from app import AuditChain, AuditChainStateError, ZERO

NEL = chr(0x85)
LS = chr(0x2028)
PS = chr(0x2029)
SEPARATORS = (NEL, LS, PS)


def dumps(obj):
    # keep the separator characters as raw UTF-8, the way an external writer
    # that did not ASCII-escape them would put them on the wire
    return json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False)


class LFLineBoundaryTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.tmp = TemporaryDirectory()
        self.path = Path(self.tmp.name) / "audit.jsonl"
        self.chain = AuditChain(self.path)

    def tearDown(self):
        self.tmp.cleanup()

    # ---- construction helpers ----------------------------------------

    def record(self, tenant, seq, event, prev):
        item = {"tenant": tenant, "seq": seq, "event": event, "prev": prev}
        item["hash"] = AuditChain._hash(item)
        return item

    def build_bytes(self, spec, nl=b"\n", trailing=True):
        """spec: list of (tenant, event). Weaves independent per-tenant
        chains and returns raw JSONL bytes with the chosen line ending."""
        state = {}
        chunks = []
        for tenant, event in spec:
            key = dumps(tenant)
            count, prev = state.get(key, (0, ZERO))
            item = self.record(tenant, count + 1, event, prev)
            chunks.append(dumps(item).encode("utf-8"))
            state[key] = (count + 1, item["hash"])
        ending = nl if trailing else b""
        return nl.join(chunks) + ending

    def every_split(self, data):
        # yield chunk lists that cut the bytes at every possible offset,
        # including cuts through the middle of a multi-byte UTF-8 sequence
        for cut in range(0, len(data) + 1):
            yield [data[:cut], data[cut:]]
        if len(data) >= 3:
            for cut1 in range(1, len(data) - 1):
                for cut2 in range(cut1 + 1, len(data)):
                    yield [data[:cut1], data[cut1:cut2], data[cut2:]]

    # ---- raw separators are content, in every JSON position ----------

    def positions(self, ch):
        return {
            "tenant": ("t" + ch + "x", "e"),
            "event": ("t", "a" + ch + "b"),
            "object_key": ("t", {"k" + ch: 1}),
            "array": ("t", ["a", ch, 3, [ch]]),
            "nested": ("t", {"n": {"deep": [{"x": ch}]}}),
        }

    def test_raw_separator_in_every_position_is_one_record(self):
        for ch in SEPARATORS:
            for label, (tenant, event) in self.positions(ch).items():
                spec = [(tenant, event), (tenant, {"again": ch})]
                for nl in (b"\n", b"\r\n"):
                    data = self.build_bytes(spec, nl=nl)
                    # one physical line per record regardless of splitlines()
                    self.assertEqual(data.count(b"\n"), 2, (ch, label, nl))
                    self.assertGreaterEqual(
                        len(data.decode("utf-8").splitlines()), 2,
                        (ch, label, nl))
                    self.assertEqual(
                        self.chain.verify_bytes(data, tenant),
                        {"ok": True, "count": 2}, (ch, label, nl))
                    result = self.chain.verify_all_bytes(data)
                    self.assertTrue(result["ok"], (ch, label, nl, result))
                    self.assertEqual(result["tenants"][0]["count"], 2,
                                     (ch, label))

    def test_separator_value_round_trips_verbatim(self):
        for ch in SEPARATORS:
            data = self.build_bytes([("t" + ch, ["x" + ch])])
            self.path.write_bytes(data)
            records = self.chain.read_tenant("t" + ch)
            self.assertEqual(len(records), 1)
            self.assertEqual(records[0]["event"], ["x" + ch])
            self.assertEqual(records[0]["tenant"], "t" + ch)
            os.unlink(self.path)

    # ---- interleaving exotic tenants ---------------------------------

    def test_separator_tenants_interleave(self):
        a, b = "A" + LS, "B" + NEL
        spec = [(a, 1), (b, "x"), (a, 2), (b, "y"), (a, 3)]
        for nl in (b"\n", b"\r\n"):
            data = self.build_bytes(spec, nl=nl)
            self.assertEqual(
                self.chain.verify_bytes(data, a), {"ok": True, "count": 3})
            self.assertEqual(
                self.chain.verify_bytes(data, b), {"ok": True, "count": 2})
            result = self.chain.verify_all_bytes(data)
            self.assertTrue(result["ok"])
            self.assertEqual([t["tenant"] for t in result["tenants"]], [a, b])
            self.assertEqual([t["count"] for t in result["tenants"]], [3, 2])
            self.assertEqual(
                self.chain.verify_bytes(data, "C" + PS),
                {"ok": True, "count": 0})

    # ---- no final newline ---------------------------------------------

    def test_no_trailing_newline_still_one_physical_line(self):
        data = self.build_bytes([("t", "a"), ("t", "b")], trailing=False)
        self.assertFalse(data.endswith(b"\n"))
        self.assertEqual(self.chain.verify_bytes(data, "t"),
                         {"ok": True, "count": 2})
        self.assertTrue(self.chain.verify_all_bytes(data)["ok"])
        # file snapshot path: head/read/append all cope, and append inserts
        # exactly one separating LF without touching existing bytes
        self.path.write_bytes(data)
        self.assertEqual(self.chain.head("t")["count"], 2)
        before = self.path.read_bytes()
        item = self.chain.append("t", "c")
        after = self.path.read_bytes()
        self.assertEqual(after, before + b"\n" + dumps(item).encode())
        self.assertEqual(self.chain.verify("t"), {"ok": True, "count": 3})

    # ---- CRLF ----------------------------------------------------------

    def test_crlf_and_mixed_endings(self):
        spec = [("t", 1), ("u", 1), ("t", 2)]
        items_state = {}
        lines = []
        for tenant, event in spec:
            key = dumps(tenant)
            count, prev = items_state.get(key, (0, ZERO))
            item = self.record(tenant, count + 1, event, prev)
            lines.append(dumps(item).encode("utf-8"))
            items_state[key] = (count + 1, item["hash"])
        data = lines[0] + b"\r\n" + lines[1] + b"\n" + lines[2] + b"\r\n"
        self.assertEqual(data.count(b"\n"), 3)
        self.assertEqual(self.chain.verify_bytes(data, "t"),
                         {"ok": True, "count": 2})
        self.assertEqual(self.chain.verify_bytes(data, "u"),
                         {"ok": True, "count": 1})
        self.assertTrue(self.chain.verify_all_bytes(data)["ok"])
        self.path.write_bytes(data)
        self.assertEqual(len(self.chain.read_tenant("t")), 2)
        # appending keeps CRLF bytes intact and verifies afterwards
        self.chain.append("u", 2)
        self.assertTrue(self.path.read_bytes().startswith(lines[0] + b"\r\n"))
        self.assertEqual(self.chain.verify_all()["ok"], True)

    # ---- arbitrary byte chunking --------------------------------------

    def test_chunks_split_through_multibyte_separators(self):
        data = self.build_bytes(
            [("t" + LS, [NEL]), ("u", {"k" + PS: 1}),
             ("t" + LS, "z" + NEL + PS)])
        # sanity: the bytes really carry raw multi-byte sequences
        self.assertIn(" ".encode(), data)
        for chunks in self.every_split(data):
            self.assertEqual(
                self.chain.verify_all_chunks(iter(chunks))["ok"], True,
                chunks)
            self.assertEqual(
                self.chain.verify_chunks(iter(chunks), "t" + LS),
                {"ok": True, "count": 2}, chunks)
            self.assertEqual(
                self.chain.verify_chunks(iter(chunks), "u"),
                {"ok": True, "count": 1}, chunks)
            # empty chunks may appear anywhere
            padded = [b""] + sum(([c, b""] for c in chunks), [])
            self.assertTrue(
                self.chain.verify_all_chunks(iter(padded))["ok"])

    # ---- bare CR is illegal wherever strict JSON forbids it -----------

    def test_bare_cr_inside_string_is_missing(self):
        good = self.build_bytes([("t", 1)])
        raw = b'{"tenant":"t","seq":2,"event":"a\rb","prev":"' \
              + good and json.loads(good)["hash"].encode()
        # build the offending record explicitly with a valid-looking hash
        first = json.loads(good)
        bad = {"tenant": "t", "seq": 2, "event": "a\rb",
               "prev": first["hash"]}
        bad["hash"] = AuditChain._hash(bad)
        line = (json.dumps(bad, ensure_ascii=False)
                .replace("\\r", "\r")).encode("utf-8") + b"\n"
        self.assertIn(b"\r", line)
        data = good + line
        r = self.chain.verify_bytes(data, "t")
        self.assertEqual((r["ok"], r["at"], r["reason"]),
                         (False, 2, "missing"))
        self.assertEqual(self.chain.verify_all_bytes(data),
                         {"ok": False, "at": 2, "tenant": "t",
                          "reason": "missing"})

    def test_bare_cr_between_records_without_lf_is_missing(self):
        # CR is whitespace to JSON, so two objects separated only by a CR on
        # one LF physical line are extra-data on that single line -> missing
        one = dumps(self.record("t", 1, {}, ZERO)).encode()
        two = dumps(self.record("t", 2, {}, "x" * 64)).encode()
        data = one + b"\r" + two + b"\n"
        self.assertEqual(data.count(b"\n"), 1)
        r = self.chain.verify_bytes(data, "t")
        self.assertEqual((r["ok"], r["at"], r["reason"]),
                         (False, 1, "missing"))

    # ---- separators outside a structure are structural garbage -------

    def test_separator_outside_structure_is_missing(self):
        one = dumps(self.record("t", 1, {}, ZERO)).encode()
        other = dumps(self.record("t", 2, {}, "x" * 64)).encode()
        for ch in SEPARATORS:
            sep = ch.encode("utf-8")
            # two valid objects joined only by a separator: one LF line now,
            # strict JSON must reject it (previously splitlines() wrongly made
            # it two parseable lines)
            data = one + sep + other + b"\n"
            r = self.chain.verify_bytes(data, "t")
            self.assertEqual((r["ok"], r["at"], r["reason"]),
                             (False, 1, "missing"), ch)
            # trailing separator after one object: extra data
            data = one + sep + b"\n"
            r = self.chain.verify_bytes(data, "t")
            self.assertEqual((r["at"], r["reason"]), (1, "missing"), ch)
            # a separator-only physical line of its own
            data = one + b"\n" + sep + b"\n"
            r = self.chain.verify_bytes(data, "t")
            self.assertEqual((r["at"], r["reason"]), (2, "missing"), ch)

    # ---- first-error priority, lines counted by LF --------------------

    def test_first_error_priority_with_separator_records(self):
        good1 = self.build_bytes([("t", LS), ("o", 1), ("t" + LS, 2)])
        good_records = [json.loads(l) for l in
                        good1.decode("utf-8").split("\n") if l]
        exotic_line = good1.count(b"\n")
        # follow-up chain defects after the exotic valid records
        tail = good_records[-1]
        cases = []
        seq_bad = self.record("t" + LS, 9, {}, tail["hash"])
        cases.append(("sequence", seq_bad, exotic_line + 1))
        digest_bad = self.record("t" + LS, 4, {}, "9" * 64)
        cases.append(("digest", digest_bad, exotic_line + 1))
        cases.append(("missing", None, exotic_line + 1))
        for reason, item, at in cases:
            if item is None:
                rest = b"{not json\n"
            else:
                rest = dumps(item).encode() + b"\n"
            r = self.chain.verify_bytes(good1 + rest, "t" + LS)
            self.assertEqual((r["ok"], r["at"], r["reason"]),
                             (False, at, reason), reason)

    def test_earlier_corruption_beats_later_separator_record(self):
        # line 1 has a bad digest; a perfectly valid raw-LS record sits on
        # LF line 2 -- the line-1 defect still wins
        tampered = {"tenant": "t", "seq": 1, "event": {"z": 9}, "prev": ZERO}
        tampered["hash"] = AuditChain._hash(
            {"tenant": "t", "seq": 1, "event": {}, "prev": ZERO})
        line1 = dumps(tampered).encode() + b"\n"
        line2 = self.build_bytes([("t", "a" + LS + "b")])
        r = self.chain.verify_bytes(line1 + line2, "t")
        self.assertEqual((r["at"], r["reason"]), (1, "digest"))

    def test_illegal_utf8_line_number_counts_lf(self):
